title: Less Wasted
text:
Less Wasted


Fermented naturally low-alcohol drinks made in Utrecht







Less Wasted makes fermented low alcohol drinks for people who want something better to drink, without overthinking it. Not overloaded with sugar, not full of artificial sweeteners, and definitely not “free” versions of other drinks.
Instead of mixing ingredients together at the end, we start at the beginning. Our drinks are brewed and slowly fermented, which means the sugar is mostly transformed into flavour, natural bubbles and all the complexity that makes a drink actually interesting.
We work with organic ingredients, source locally where we can, and often use things that would normally be thrown away, like fruit peels, and turn them into something genuinely good. The result is a drink that feels fresh, a bit different, and easy to come back to.
To see what drinks are available click here.

title: Sunshine into tea
text: Kombucha needs green tea. Boiling tens of litres uses a significant amount of energy which adds to our overheads. In Utrecht, there is plentiful supply of solar energy from locally produced photovoltaic panels (PV) installed on locals roofs and from the Utrecht solar farm. Taking care to only boil this water on these days not only means we use low carbon energy, but we help the local grid which struggles to make use of all this cheap energy. As a result we even get paid for this, keeping costs down.
